weaknesses.title: DROP family matrix: DROPNTH bag, DROPFILELINE index, DROPMATCHFILE needle, DROPALLMATCHFILE purge
weaknesses.detail: Four different DROP* shapes. Wrong op drops wrong thing or soft-misses. Agents must distinguish index vs needle vs bag vs bulk.
weaknesses.repro: DROPFILELINE p 1 vs DROPMATCHFILE p DEBUG

weaknesses.title: Substring false friends: DEB purges DEBUG lines
weaknesses.detail: No whole-word mode. Short purge needles over-delete config rows.
weaknesses.repro: DROPALLMATCHFILE p DEB removes DEBUG full

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON multi-line dropped bag glues without NL
weaknesses.detail: Plate DROPPED has NL between removed lines; PRINT_JSON → DEBUG 1DEBUG 2. Recurring.

weaknesses.title: DROPALLMATCHFILE_I is only first removed index, not full index list
weaknesses.detail: N counts removals; I is first hit only. Agents cannot reconstruct which indices vanished without pre-scan GREPFILE.

weaknesses.title: No dry-run / preview for DROPALLMATCHFILE
weaknesses.detail: Bulk purge is immediate rewrite. GREPFILE can preview but is a separate op agents must remember.

weaknesses.title: WRITE trailing NL omit on DROPPED plate and last file line
weaknesses.detail: cat -A DROPPED last line often no $; rewritten cfg same class.

weaknesses.title: Empty DROP*MATCH needle is safe zero — but inconsistent with GREPFILE empty match-all
weaknesses.detail: Good for purge safety; still part of empty-needle policy chaos across file ops.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE env silently disables hard fail
